questionnaire.title: Brand discovery
questionnaire.description: A short brief so the studio can lock scope before kickoff. You can save and return later.

questions.title: Company name
questions.helperText: The name that should appear on the identity and guidelines.
questions.internalNotes: Maps to cover and brand guideline title.

questions.title: Primary contact email
questions.helperText: We will use this for reviews and file delivery.

questions.title: Phone number
questions.helperText: Optional. Include the country code if you have one.

questions.title: Current website
questions.helperText: Leave blank if there is no site yet.

questions.title: What should this identity achieve?
questions.helperText: Audience, competitors, and the feeling the brand should leave.
questions.internalNotes: Feed this into the discovery workshop agenda.

questions.title: Deliverables you need
questions.helperText: Select everything that should be in scope.

questions.title: Do you have an existing logo?
questions.internalNotes: If yes, ask for files before the workshop.

questions.title: Current logo
questions.helperText: PNG or SVG preferred.

questions.title: Other brand assets
questions.helperText: Guidelines, fonts, photography, or previous proposals.

questions.title: How clear is the current brand?
questions.helperText: 1 is unclear, 5 is already distinctive.

questions.title: Approximate budget (USD)
questions.helperText: A range is fine. This is not a quote.

questions.title: A colour you already associate with the brand
Anything else we should know?
questions.helperText: Links, references, or constraints.
